page.layout: Top: page number centred. One column of running text with a centred spaced heading "THEMA LXI." Drop-cap woodcut initial "A" at the start of the thema paragraph. Signature "Hh" at the foot right under the last line. No margin notes, no running head, no catchword.

main_text.p: Sequuntur porrò XL themata ejuf-dem argumenti cum LX præcedentibus partim ex vetere, partim ex novo Testamento deprompta: sicuti converfa leguntur in Latinum à M. Sebastiano Castalione: in quo legendo majorem fe percipere fructum olim dicebat Joannes Checus, vir doctus, & equeftris ordinis (teste Chri-stophoro Carleilo Anglo) quàm in evolvendis omnium scriptorum commentariis.
main_text.head: THEMA LXI.

p.i: ADamus autem cum Eva uxorem habuit, quæ gravida facta Cainum peperit: sic ideo nominatum, quod illa eum enixa dixisset, Adepta sum virum à Jova. Peperit prate-rea ejus germanum Abelem. Hic Abelopilio, Cainus fuit agricola. Aliquanto tempore post, cum Jova munus libavisset Cainus de terra frugibus: Abel autem de pecorum suorum primigenis, & max.mè[?] optimis, respexit Jova Abelem, & ejus mu-

page.notes: Lower edge of the last line is cut by the page foot, so the sentence continues on the next page. Woodcut initial "A" is decorative and read as the first letter of "Adamus". "Abelopilio" is set as one word with no printed hyphen at the line end. "max.mè" is unclear; the dot after "max" may be a damaged letter, so it is marked [?]. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout.
